how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper containing your Bio-Data, name, and address of two references.
Affix a latest passport size photograph onto the application.
Gather attested photocopies of all supporting documents along with original certificates.
Obtain a No Objection Certificate if currently employed.
Directly attend the walk-in interview on 17.10.2026 at 11.00 AM at the Chamber of Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the interview. The post is purely temporary and on a consolidated basis for two semesters only. Employed candidates must submit a No objection certificate at the time of interview. The decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects.

faq.question: Q1. What is the PJTSAU Teaching Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University to hire 2 Teaching Associates for the Department of Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Teaching Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 17.10.2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M. Sc (Ag.) in Soil Sci. & Agricultural Chemistry, with a Ph.D. in the same discipline considered a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PJTSAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Ph.D. degree receive Rs. 54,000/- per month, while those without a Ph.D. degree receive Rs. 49,000/- per month consolidated without HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview takes place at the Chamber of Associate Dean, College of Agriculture, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to apply online?
faq.answer: No, candidates can directly attend the interview on the specified date with an application on plain paper and original certificates.
